caption: A close-up shot of a paddle making contact with the ping pong ball, showing the impact.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A close-up shot of a paddle making contact with the ping pong ball, showing the impact. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The paddle must be positioned to make contact with the ball near the net.
The ball must be in motion toward the paddle at the moment of impact.
The paddle must strike the ball with sufficient force to propel it across the net.
The camera must maintain a close-up view focused on the point of contact between the paddle and the ball.
